name: Can mold damage come back after professional repair?

mainEntity.name: Can mold damage come back after professional repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can potentially return after professional repair if the underlying moisture source that caused the initial growth is not fully identified and addressed. A reputable mold remediation service will always aim to find and fix the moisture problem, whether it's a leaky pipe, roof defect, or poor ventilation. If the source is properly mitigated, the chances of recurrence are significantly reduced. It's crucial to maintain good ventilation and quickly address any new water intrusions to prevent future mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can return if the original moisture source isn't fixed. Professional repair includes addressing the cause to prevent recurrence.
